title: Product Manager
description: Lead product strategy, define feature roadmaps, conduct market research, and coordinate between design, engineering, and marketing teams to launch successful digital products.
requirements: 3+ years in Agile Product Management, proficiency with Jira/Confluence, strong data analysis capability, and exceptional stakeholder management skills.

title: Mobile App Developer (React Native)
description: Build high-performance cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native, integrating backend GraphQL endpoints and native device APIs.
requirements: 2+ years React Native experience, proficiency with Xcode and Android Studio native build tooling, state management, and app store deployment processes.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description: Architect and build modern, highly responsive user interfaces using React and Next.js for scalable web applications.
requirements: 5+ years frontend experience, expertise in TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, and Web Vitals optimization.

title: Backend Software Engineer
description: Design and maintain microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, and database schemes handling high-throughput traffic.
requirements: 3+ years experience with Node.js/Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, and hands-on exposure to Docker and Kubernetes.

title: UX/UI Designer
description: Create intuitive user flows, high-fidelity wireframes, and interactive prototypes for web and mobile products.
requirements: 3+ years in product design, mastery of Figma, user research experience, and a strong portfolio.

title: Data Scientist
description: Build machine learning models and predictive analytics solutions to derive actionable insights from complex datasets.
requirements: Strong background in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, SQL, and a Master's or BS in CS, Statistics, or Math.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate CI/CD pipelines, manage AWS infrastructure via Terraform, and ensure 99.99% system availability.
requirements: 3+ years AWS/GCP administration, proficiency in Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Linux shell scripting.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Manage multi-channel PPC campaigns, SEO strategies, and conversion rate optimization to boost user acquisition.
requirements: 2+ years handling Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, and proven track record of scaling ROI.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitor network traffic for threats, perform vulnerability assessments, and execute incident response procedures.
requirements: CompTIA Security+ or CISSP certification, hands-on experience with SIEM tools and threat modeling.

title: Full Stack Engineer (MERN)
description: Develop end-to-end web features using MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js for SaaS clients.
requirements: 3+ years with JavaScript/TypeScript, experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, and state management.

title: Technical Writer
description: Produce developer-focused API documentation, SDK quickstarts, and comprehensive platform guides.
requirements: Experience reading code (JS/Python), Markdown fluency, and familiarity with Git/GitHub workflows.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Design, write, and execute automated test suites for web and mobile platforms to maintain high code quality.
requirements: Proficiency with Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium, plus strong knowledge of CI/CD integration.

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description: Lead enterprise cloud migration strategies, design resilient system architecture, and optimize cloud costs.
requirements: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, 7+ years in IT infrastructure and enterprise systems.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description: Fine-tune large language models, build RAG pipelines, and integrate AI APIs into commercial products.
requirements: Strong Python skills, experience with LangChain/LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, and vector databases (Pinecone/Weaviate).

title: SEO & Content Manager
description: Develop and execute keyword strategies, perform technical SEO audits, and manage a team of freelance writers.
requirements: 3+ years in SEO management, proficiency with Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and WordPress.

title: Database Administrator
description: Maintain database performance, perform regular backups, execute data migrations, and optimize slow queries.
requirements: Expertise in PostgreSQL, MySQL, database replication, clustering, and disaster recovery planning.

title: Scrum Master
description: Facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove team blockers, and coach cross-functional engineering teams on best practices.
requirements: CSM or PSM I certification, 3+ years experience facilitating software engineering teams using Jira.

title: iOS Developer (Swift)
description: Develop native iOS applications using SwiftUI and Combine, focusing on smooth animations and low memory overhead.
requirements: 4+ years iOS experience, deep knowledge of Xcode, Swift, and App Store submission workflows.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Onboard B2B enterprise clients, drive platform adoption, and maintain low churn rates through proactive relationship building.
requirements: 2+ years in SaaS Customer Success or Account Management, experience using Salesforce or Gainsight.

title: Business Analyst
description: Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and build financial models for new initiatives.
requirements: Strong SQL skills, Tableau/PowerBI experience, and 3+ years analyzing operational workflows.

title: Graphic Designer
description: Produce promotional graphics, social media assets, brand guidelines, and marketing collateral across digital platforms.
requirements: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), plus basic video editing skills.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description: Optimize system performance, conduct incident post-mortems, and build automated tooling to prevent outages.
requirements: Strong Linux fundamentals, Go/Python coding ability, and deep understanding of Prometheus/Grafana.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description: Lead go-to-market strategies, craft competitive positioning messaging, and produce sales enablement collateral.
requirements: 4+ years in B2B product marketing, excellent writing skills, and experience leading product launches.

title: Android Developer (Kotlin)
description: Design native Android applications using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and modern Android architecture patterns.
requirements: 3+ years Kotlin development, familiarity with Coroutines, Dagger/Hilt, and RESTful API integration.

title: Data Engineer
description: Build robust ETL/ELT pipelines, manage Snowflake data warehouses, and streamline real-time data streaming.
requirements: Proficiency in Apache Spark, Airflow, SQL, and Python, plus cloud data warehouse management.

title: Ethical Hacker / Penetration Tester
description: Conduct authorized security assessments, penetration testing, and code audits to identify security flaws.
requirements: OSCP certification preferred, deep knowledge of OWASP Top 10, Metasploit, and network exploitation.

title: Sales Development Representative
description: Execute outbound prospecting calls and email sequences to qualify leads and schedule product demos.
requirements: 1+ years outbound cold outreach experience, strong written communication, and CRM familiarity.

title: Solution Architect (Pre-Sales)
description: Partner with account executives to present technical demos, answer RFPs, and design custom client solutions.
requirements: 5+ years in pre-sales engineering or cloud architecture, comfortable presenting to C-level executives.

title: HR Manager
description: Manage talent acquisition, employee relations, onboarding workflows, and company culture initiatives.
requirements: SHRM-CP certification preferred, 4+ years generalist HR experience in medium-sized organizations.

title: Motion Graphics Designer
description: Create 2D/3D animated assets, video openers, and interactive product videos for marketing campaigns.
requirements: Expertise in After Effects, Cinema 4D, Premiere Pro, and a strong showreel of recent work.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description: Develop low-level firmware for connected hardware products using C/C++ and microcontrollers.
requirements: 3+ years writing embedded C/C++, experience with RTOS, SPI, I2C, UART protocols, and PCB debugging.

title: Social Media Community Manager
description: Manage brand channels on LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and Instagram, engage with followers, and create organic content.
requirements: 2+ years running brand social accounts, strong written copy skills, and basic graphic design knowledge.
